gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Cherry Swash has a wide horseshoe c and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, which gives it a distinctive swagger. And Tsukimi Rounded follows in sans-serif form, its round shapes like open parentheses and its edges running parallel through every curve.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tuffy: Tuffy reads like a sans-serif sketched in pencil that never presses harder, with an s whose halves part widely. Under Cherry Swash's commanding display heading, text would move along smoothly and contemporary.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-urbanist: Urbanist writes like a rolling-ball pen. Its single-width trail never curls shut, so paragraphs under Cherry Swash's horseshoe c would glide along without snagging.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-varela: Varela has a wide-mouthed c and a t built from one width. Under Cherry Swash, a heading with heavy diagonals and a horseshoe c, longer text would feel modern and approachable, never fussy.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-varela-round: Modern, clean and rounded: that's Varela Round, with counters framed by uniform strokes. Cherry Swash adds commanding weight up top, and the strongest quality of the pair is how firmly that sturdy heading meets such soft, wide-mouthed lowercase.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-varta: Big, bold shapes up top, wide-eyed text below. Varta gives every e and a a generous open eye, while Cherry Swash holds its strokes at a flat weight with no thick-to-thin shading, so the two read as clearly different voices.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-vazirmatn: Heavy swagger meets easy openness. Cherry Swash is best at commanding attention, with curves and straights sharing one width, while Vazirmatn does its best work quietly, its wide-open s never tightening.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-wix-madefor-displ: Distinctive from the first line, Cherry Swash sets a horseshoe c and curves that match its stems exactly. And Wix Madefor Display sits beneath it as a plain sans, its gently flared curve ends staying apart.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-wix-madefor-text: Commanding up top, Cherry Swash turns its corners with no pressure swell, its horseshoe c wide and its diagonals hefty. Wix Madefor Text follows as a plain sans with open terminals that ease the eye along.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-ysabeau: Sturdy, flat-lined display lettering with a horseshoe c. Beneath Cherry Swash, Ysabeau's sweeping sans-serif curves never close up, so a long page of text would feel approachable and unhurried.
